          id,
          amount,
          currency,
          description,
          date,
          civil_date,
          local_time,
          time_zone,
          date_precision,
          account_id,
          category_id,
          subcategory_id,
          type,
          direction,
          status,
          target_account_id,
          merchant_name,
          payment_method,
          credit_card_hint,
          dedupe_key,
          notes,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        FROM transactions
        ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC;

     FROM transactions INDEXED BY idx_transactions_date
     WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND (
